summary: Providence County tower that the Rhode Island index marks as gone; no other source found.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association's Rhode Island index marks the tower as gone.

evidence.supports: Index lists Blackstone as a gone tower in Providence County at 41.91909, -71.48684

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: one index row. The per-tower page under firelookout.org/lookouts/ri/ is not in the cache and returns 404. Two WebSearch calls found no build, staffing or removal details; the Rhode Island chapter reports and pages returned cover other towers. The brief's county and coordinates match the index row. The story is about 50 words, below the 120-word floor, because the evidence supports no more. Editor should decide whether to hold it or publish it as a short stub.
